senses.gloss:
mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 A helper, a friend or patron.
2 A preserver, a cherisher.
3 Who or what hides or conceals.
m. (-पः)
1 Superintendent of a district.
2 The head of a cowpen.
3 A herdsman, a cowherd, a milkman by caste and occupation.
4 A king.
5 Myrrh: see गोपरस.
f. (-पा or -पी)
A plant, (Echites frutescens).
f. (-पा)
A milkwoman, a female cowherd.
f. (-पी)
1 A cowherd's wife, but especially applied to those of Vṛndāvana, the companions and objects of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile sports, and who are considered sometimes as holy or celestial personages.
2 A protectress.
3 Nature, elementary nature.
E.
गो the earth, &c. and प what preserves; also in some senses गुप to hide, to protect, &c. affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
One who guards or protects.
(-कः)
1 Myrrh.
2 The superintendant of a district.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-न्या)
1 The daughter of a cowherd.
2 A nymph of Vṛndāvana.
3 A medicinal plant.
E.
गोप, and कन्या a daughter.

f. (-ण्टा)
A wild sort of jujube, (Zizyphus nepeca.)
E.
गोप a cowherd, and घोण्टा the jujube.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 Of INDRA.
3 The sun.
4 A king.
5 A bull.
E.
गो the earth, &c. and पति lord or master.

m. (-पः)
The rainbow.
E.
गोपति INDRA, and चाप a bow.

m. (लः)
The areca tree.
E.
गोप preserving, and दल a leaf.

n. (-नं)
1 Protecting, guarding.
2 Concealment, hiding.
3 Reviling, abuse.
4 Flurry, hurry, alarm.
5 Light, lustre.
6 The leaf of the Laurus cassia.
E.
गुप to hide, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Secret, mysterious, to be concealed or hidden.
2 To be preserved or protected.
E.
गुप to hide, &c. अनीयर् aff.

f. (-धूः)
1 The wife of a cowherd.
2 A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.)
E.
गोप, and वधू a wife.

f. (-टी)
The youthful wife of a cowherd.

m. (-द्रः)
The fibrous root of a waterlily.
E.
गोप a cowherd, and भद्र lucky, auspicious.

f. (-का)
The name of a tree: see गम्भारी.
E.
गोप a preserver, and भद्र auspicious, and कन् and टाप् affs.

m. (-सः)
Gum myrrh.
E.
गोप secret, and रस juice, exuding in a manner or place unknown.

f. (-ल्ली)
1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens): see श्यामलता.
2 Another plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.)
E.
गोप a cowherd, and वल्ली a pedicle, being used in medicines for cattle.

m. (-कः)
A cowherd.
E.
गो, and पाटविक clever.

f. (-सी)
1 The wood of a thatch.
2 A crooked beam which supports it.
3 The bamboo frame work on which it rests.
E.
गोप preserving, affixes नसट् and ङीष्, आ inserted.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
A preserver, a cherisher, one who guards or protects.
E.
गुप to preserve, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Preserved, protected, cherished.
E.
गुप to protect, affix क्त.

m. (-लः)
1 A king, a sovereign.
2 A cowherd.
3 A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
गो the earth, &c. and पाल who preserves or protects.

m. (-कः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 KṚṢṆA.
3 A cow keeper or protector.
E.
गो a cow or the earth, पाल् to cherish, and वुन् aff.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of worm.
2 A female cowherd: see गोपालक.

f. (-मी)
The eighth lunation of the light half of Kārttika, on which KṚṢṆA became a cowherd; cows are to be worshipped.
E.
गोप, and अष्टमी the eighth.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
A protector, one who preserves or protects.
f. (-नी)
1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.)
2 A cowherd's wife.
E.
गुप to preserve, णिनि and ङीष् affs.

f. (-का)
A female cowherd, &c.: see गोपक.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
One who preserves or protects.
E.
गुप, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
A species of white clay, said to be brought from Dvārakā, and used by the worshippers of VIṢṆU to smear their faces with.
E.
गोपी, and चन्दन Sandal.

m. (-थः)
Preserving, protecting.
n. (-थं)
A holy place, a place of pilgrimage.
E.
गोप preserving, and थक् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-च्छः)
1 A cowtail.
2 A sort of necklace, one of four or thirty-four strings.
3 A sort of monkey.
E.
गो a cow, and पुच्छ a tail, resembling or possessing a cow's tail.

f. (-टा)
Large cardamoms.

n. (-कं)
A temple or edifice consecrated to ŚIVA'S bull.
E.
गो a cow, and पट to enclose, affix इकन्.

n. (-रं)
1 A town gate.
2 A gate in general.
3 The ornamented gateway of a temple.
4 A kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
गुप to preserve, and ऊरच् aff.

n. (-षं)
Cowdung.
E.
गो, and पुरीष dung.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
गोप a cowherd, and इन्द्र lord or chief.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of ŚĀKYA MUNI, a Buddha.
2 A name of KṚṢṆA.
3 A chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine.
4 A name of NANDA.
E.
गोप a cowherd, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ)
A preserver, a protector, one who defends or cherishes.
E.
गुप to preserve, &c. affix तृच्.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
1 To be cherished or preserved.
2 To be kept secret or hidden.
3 To be kept, to be taken care of.
m. (-प्यः)
1 A slave.
2 The son of a female slave.
E.
गुप to preserve, &c. ण्य aff.

m. (-कः)
A servant or slave.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-धिः)
A pledge, that is not to be used, but to be carefully preserved.
E.
गोप्य to be preserved, and आधि a pledge.

n. (-ण्डं)
An excellent cow.
E.
गो a cow, and प्रकाण्ड excellent; the compound is always neuter.

m. (-रः)
Pasturage ground.
E.
गो, and प्रचार going.
